description: This Java class defines the ConceptReferenceRange entity for OpenMRS, representing numeric value ranges associated with concepts such as age and gender, including database mappings and accessor methods.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceRange
classes.description: Entity class representing a concept reference range in OpenMRS, including fields for ID, criteria, and associated numeric concept, with JPA annotations for persistence.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the ConceptReferenceRange.

methods.name: setConceptReferenceRangeId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the ConceptReferenceRange.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves the criteria string defining conditions for the reference range.

methods.name: setCriteria
methods.description: Defines the criteria string for the reference range.

methods.name: getConceptNumeric
methods.description: Gets the associated ConceptNumeric object for this reference range.

methods.name: setConceptNumeric
methods.description: Sets the ConceptNumeric object associated with this reference range.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements OpenmrsObject#getId to retrieve the entity's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements OpenmrsObject#setId to assign the entity's ID.
